title: TTSManifest
description: The MEASURED (never estimated) narration timing for script_manifest.json's blocks. Produced by a TTS rendering step (not yet built -- this file defines only the data contract) that runs AFTER script ingestion and BEFORE B-DISCOVER: since the master script is already complete and locked, there is no outline-estimate intermediary anymore -- B-DISCOVER plans visual coverage directly against real audio duration. duration_sec must come from probing the actual rendered audio file (e.g. scripts/media_probe.py's probe()), never copied or guessed from anywhere else. B-EDIT computes each block's position on the final documentary timeline deterministically as a running sum over script_manifest.json's own block order: block N starts exactly where block N-1 ended.

status.description: pending: audio not fully rendered yet (zero or partial blocks present is normal). generated: EVERY script_manifest.json block has exactly one measured entry here -- a partial set must not use this status. B-DISCOVER/B-EDIT treat production as not-yet-ready until this is generated; the validator enforces full block coverage whenever this is set.

blocks.description: One entry per script_manifest.json block whose narration audio has been rendered and measured. Entries may appear in any order -- lookups are by block_id; cumulative timing is reconstructed from script_manifest.json's own block order, not this array's order.

audio_path.description: Local path to the rendered narration audio for this block

duration_sec.description: MEASURED duration of audio_path -- e.g. via scripts/media_probe.py's probe(). Never an estimate.
